mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; tolterodine is metabolized via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, with potential for additive cognitive/sedative effects.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (cognitive impairment, urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth) and CNS depression; consider dose adjustment or alternative agent if excessive effects occur.
